title: HPCG Supercomputer Performance: June 2026
desc: The top ten systems in the June 2026 High-Performance Conjugate Gradient (HPCG) list. This benchmark emphasizes memory access and communication behavior and differs from HPL. Coverage is limited to submitted HPCG results, not every supercomputer worldwide.

source.name: TOP500 — HPCG June 2026 list
source.note: Verified by the AllRanks assistant on 2026-10-31 against the official June 2026 HPCG full list and its top-ten summary: compared all ten system names, countries, ranks and HPCG values in TFlop/s. Stored values are HPCG results, not the adjacent HPL Rmax column in PFlop/s. This is a top-ten extract of submitted HPCG results, not a census of all supercomputers or an application-independent performance ranking; systems without a submitted HPCG result are excluded.
